name: Indigo + Memory
source:
Indigo organization collects and teaches kids with paranormal abilities in their school, the heads of this organization are so-called Elders. After graduating all students are placed in teams, which then go on missions to do all the dirty work for organization.

Six months ago Constantine was one of the graduates and now he is a part of a newly assembled team. He never liked the system in which he was forced to be because of his power, he always dreamed of running away, but was afraid to try it or that's what he thought.

[From [url=https://rivarsstudio.itch.io/indigomemory]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
靛蓝组织在学校里收集和教导具有超自然能力的孩子，这个组织的负责人是所谓的长老。毕业后，所有学生都被分成小组，然后执行任务，为组织做所有肮脏的工作。

六个月前，康斯坦丁是毕业生之一，现在他是新组建的团队的一员。他从来不喜欢这个因为权力而被迫的体制，他总是梦想着逃跑，但又不敢尝试，或者他就是这么想的。

[来自[url=https://rivarsstudio.itch.io/indigomemory]Itch.io[/url]]
